$description: Horizontal slide deck. Fixed viewport per slide, keyboard navigation.

background.rule: Dark-light-dark sandwich. Title and closing slides use the brand's dark surface. Content slides use light surface for readability. Same universal rule as vertical documents.

heading.rule: Heading position is identical on every content slide. Same size, same weight, same vertical position.

fontSizes.rule: Maximum 3 font sizes across the entire deck. One for headings, one for body, one for labels. No exceptions.

width.rule: Same padding on every slide. Content area is identical across all slides. No slide breaks the grid.
